author: Xbox
description:
Reloadian is a fast-paced co-op roguelike action platformer designed around tight platforms, boss combats, and replayable dungeon runs. Players experiment with different builds and abilities while pushing through challenging environments, either solo or in cross-play co-op with friends across PC and consoles. Alongside its cooperative focus, Reloadian also plans to offer PvP modes. Coming out soon!
